decision_conditions: The proposed first floor side/rear extension by reason of its size, siting, design and awkward relationship to the existing dwelling would appear bulky, incongruous, and would represent an overly dominant and visually intrusive form of development out of keeping and character with, and detrimental to the appearance and character of the host property and pattern of development within the surrounding area.  The proposal is thereby contrary to Policies D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Strategy (2010) Policy CP30 and Development Management Document (2014) Policies DMD8, DMD11, DMD13 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

The single storey rear extension by reason of its combined depth and height would have an overbearing effect upon the adjoining property No. 80 Melbourne Way that would result in a loss of outlook, detrimental to the amenities of that adjoining neighbouring property, contrary to London Plan (2021) Policies D3, Core Strategy (2010) Policies CP30, Development Management Document (2014) Polices DMD8, DMD11 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
description: Part single, part first floor side and rear extension.
